context: Tests whether the agent runs a Vite+ 0.3.x to 1.0.0-rc.0 upgrade across the Vitest 5 boundary: target-pinned migrator before any manual dependency edit, migrator findings triaged, runtime owners the migrator skips updated, public engine contract left to the team, removed binaries repointed, and local-CLI verification.

checklist.name: Migrator runs first on the original install
checklist.description: The runbook installs the existing 0.3.3 lockfile, then runs `pnpm --package=vite-plus@1.0.0-rc.0 dlx vp migrate` from the project root before any `pnpm update`, `pnpm add`, or hand-edited version, and explains that the migrator reads the original lockfile and install to detect the source Vitest version

checklist.name: No global CLI or wrapper
checklist.description: Does not install, inspect, or upgrade a global `vp`, does not use `vp upgrade` or `vp implode`, and does not add a custom migration shell script; post-install commands use `pnpm exec vp` or package scripts

checklist.name: Findings triaged
checklist.description: The runbook says to save the migrator's review report before reinstalling, fix `BLOCK` items and rerun the migrator, and resolve every `REVIEW` item before committing even though the command exits successfully

checklist.name: Runtime owners the migrator skips
checklist.description: Keeps the migrated `.nvmrc` on a supported Node and removes Node 20 from the CI matrix (every entry satisfies `^22.18.0 || ^24.11.0 || >=26.0.0`), rather than restoring `.nvmrc` or leaving CI on 20.19.0

checklist.name: Public engine contract left to the team
checklist.description: Does not silently change `engines.node`; it keeps `>=20.19.0` and flags the undecided public-contract change for the team, separating it from the test and CI runtime

checklist.name: Editor integration repointed
checklist.description: Updates `.vscode/settings.json` so it no longer points at the removed `node_modules/.bin/oxlint` and `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt` binaries, using the `vp lint --lsp` and `vp fmt --lsp` integrations or the migrator's editor setup

checklist.name: Compatibility settings kept deliberately
checklist.description: Treats `test.clearMocks: false` and `pack.deps.resolveDepSubpath` as migrator compatibility settings with removal conditions; keeps them or removes them with a stated reason and proof, not silently

checklist.name: Local toolchain and full verification
checklist.description: Verifies with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm exec vp --version` or `pnpm exec vp toolchain --json` showing vite-plus 1.0.0-rc.0 with Vitest 5.0.1, then format, `vp check`, `vp test` with coverage, and `vp pack`

checklist.name: Hold condition
checklist.description: The runbook says to keep the 0.3.3 pin when runtime or test types cannot pass on the target, rather than forcing the upgrade
